name: Menhirkin Core: The Land Stood Up

description.value:
Ancestry Core (v1.1, RFI-native). Shared across all Menhirkin heritages. Granted at character creation via the base ancestry item's ItemGrant advancement.

“The land is not scenery. The land is a person. You are the version of it that finally stood up and walked over to complain.”

Menhirkin Core Traits

  • Stone Soul. You count as Large for carry, shove, and grapple despite your Medium frame. Reroll-lowest on checks to resist being forcibly moved.
  • Hex Recognition. 1/scene, while you are on a natural surface you are directly touching, you may whisper a single question about the place. The GM answers with one true thing the land knows.
  • Slow to Wear. Reroll-lowest on Body checks against exhaustion, long-duration physical wear, forced marches, climate exposure, and sustained labor. You do not tire the way softer things tire.
  • Heavy Presence. Your weight and settledness are perceptible. Creatures within 10 ft of you know you are there even if they cannot see you; you have disadvantage on Intrigue (Stealth) checks unless you are on or in stone.
⟁ Per-Use Ability — Hex Recognition
